name: tara-vscode
description: Voice-controlled AI coding assistant powered by Gemini Live + Claude Code
author: Tara

tara.geminiApiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated: the key now lives in VS Code's encrypted SecretStorage. Any value here is moved there on first use and then cleared. Enter the key on Tara's setup screen instead.
tara.geminiApiKey.description: Legacy plaintext Gemini API key. Migrated to SecretStorage automatically.

tara.claudeCodePath.description: Path to the claude CLI binary (defaults to 'claude' on PATH). Machine-scoped so a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot point Tara at a different binary.

tara.ffmpegPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `ffmpeg` binary used as the **fallback** microphone recorder. Tara normally records through a bundled native module and needs no external tool; ffmpeg is only used where that module has no prebuilt binary. Either way capture runs in the extension host, because VS Code's webview iframes are created without `microphone` in their Permissions-Policy allow list, so `getUserMedia` cannot work there ([vscode#250568](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/250568)). Machine-scoped so a repository cannot point Tara at a different binary.
tara.ffmpegPath.description: Path to the ffmpeg binary used as the fallback microphone recorder.

tara.model.description: Model for Claude Code to use (e.g. claude-opus-5). Leave empty to use the CLI's own default.

enumDescriptions: Apply file edits without asking, but still gate other tools.
Let Claude Code decide per tool.
Never ask; skip anything that would need approval.
Skip every permission check. Use only in a throwaway workspace.
tara.permissionMode.description: Permission mode passed to Claude Code. This is the real guardrail on what agents may do. Machine-scoped so a repository cannot lower it for you.

tara.maxTurns.description: Maximum agent turns per task before Claude Code stops.

tara.maxConcurrentAgents.description: Maximum number of Claude Code agents running at once.

tara.replyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long an agent waits for your answer to a clarifying question before it closes.

tara.geminiLiveModel.description: Gemini Live model for the speech-to-speech conversation. Must support bidiGenerateContent; a native-audio model gives the best voice.

tara.language.markdownDescription:
Which language Tara listens for and replies in — for example `bn-BD` (Bengali as spoken in Bangladesh), `bn-IN`, `en-US`, `hi-IN` — or `auto` to follow whatever you speak. Set it explicitly if you have a strong accent: left on `auto` the model has to guess the language, and a wrong guess is what turns accented speech into garbled English.

The region matters here even though the speech engine ignores it. Only the primary subtag is sent as `speechConfig.languageCode` (`bn-BD` → `bn`), because the published language table has no region variants and sending one it does not list is what made Bengali come back as Hindi. The full code still reaches the model through the system instruction, where "Bengali (Bangladesh)" is a meaningful instruction. If a model refuses the code entirely, Tara reconnects without it and the instruction alone carries the setting.
tara.language.description: Language Tara listens for and replies in (BCP-47 code, or 'auto' to follow the speaker).

enumDescriptions: Does the work, and teaches you English alongside it: corrects at most two mistakes after answering, occasionally teaches one word or phrase, and stays quiet while you are mid-task.
Just does the work. No corrections, no teaching.
tara.persona.markdownDescription: Who Tara is beyond a voice front-end. `english-teacher` adds coaching **after** she has answered — never instead of answering, and never while you are in the middle of something. Corrections are capped at two per turn so a reply does not become a lesson, and she does not correct you when you speak your own language, only when you are using English.
tara.persona.description: Who Tara is: an English teacher who also does the work, or just an assistant.

tara.voiceName.description: Prebuilt Gemini voice used when Tara speaks (e.g. Aoede, Kore, Puck, Charon).

tara.speakResponses.description: Speak agent answers, clarifying questions and warnings aloud.

tara.speakerMatchThreshold.markdownDescription: How closely a voice must match your enrolled profile before Tara acts on it, from 0 to 1. Only used once you have enrolled a voice on the setup screen; with no profile Tara answers everyone. Raise it if other people in the room get through; lower it if your own voice is being ignored — a cold, a headset, or sitting further from the microphone all push the score down. A rejected score is printed in the chat, so you can see what to aim at.
tara.speakerMatchThreshold.description: Minimum voice-match score (0–1) before Tara acts on what it hears.

enumDescriptions: Click the orb to listen continuously. Audio is only sent while you are actually speaking; after 15s of silence Tara sleeps until it hears "wake up".

tara.riskConfirmation.description: Ask for confirmation before running a command that looks destructive (rm -rf, force push, DROP TABLE). Machine-scoped so a repository cannot switch the gate off.

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd webview-ui && npm install
